description: Every 30 minutes, checks each configured practice's own calendar (Outlook or Google, per the practice's email provider) for new or moved events over the next 30 days, keeps a matching Cliniko unavailable block in sync, and checks for bookings that now clash. On a clash, drafts a reschedule offer and raises a WorkQ item with the same No-show follow-up approval form used by No-show Recovery — so sending it is handled by that automation's existing Apply no-show follow-up decision flow, not a new one.
